[SWS_CM_00303] Find Service Handle
⌈
The Communication Manage-
ment shall provide the definition of an opaque FindServiceHandle with exactly this
name. FindServiceHandle shall satisfy the EqualityComparable requirements
according to table 17, the LessThanComparable requirements according to table 18,
and the CopyAssignable requirements according to table 23 of section 17.6.3.1 of
[27] to allow storing and managing FindServiceHandles in C++ container classes
by the using application. These requirements are fulfilled if the following operators are
provided: operator==, operator<, and operator=. The exact definition of Find-
ServiceHandle is communication management implementation specific.
⌋
